description: This Java class defines a Spring Batch Tasklet responsible for adding periodic accrual entries in a loan portfolio system. It utilizes services for processing accruals and handles exceptions during execution.

classes.name: AddPeriodicAccrualEntriesTasklet
classes.description: A tasklet component in a batch process that adds periodic accrual entries for loans, encapsulating the logic to invoke the accrual service and handle exceptions.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the task by invoking addPeriodicAccruals with the current business date, handling MultiException by wrapping it into a JobExecutionException.

methods.name: addPeriodicAccruals
methods.description: Calls the loan accrual processing service to add accruals up to the specified date.
